title: Typed extraction: drop GLiNER2 spans whose offsets do not select their text
description: Follow-up to the 1.16.1 clamp fix. Machines on Machines knowledge runs crashed with IndexError in _trim_span on a span past the window end (fixed by clamping in 1.16.1). Clamping alone could label the wrong text if offsets drift, so a span whose offsets do not select the text GLiNER2 returned with it is now dropped and counted in the log. Runtime finding: no per-item progress logging, output only written at the end; per-item results are cached by text hash so a re-run resumes if the corpus analysis cache persists.
